verdict.rationale: Qapita's own docs describe cap table software that serves as a 'single source of truth for founders, investors, and employees' with a 'real-time view of ownership', plus option grant management. However, the pack never mentions share classes, certificates, or SAFEs, and auditor reliance is only implied by separate audit-ready reporting and valuation products. missing for 10: documented share class management, share certificate issuance/tracking, SAFE/convertible instrument tracking, explicit auditor access to the cap table, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can maintain my full cap table — share classes, certificates, SAFEs, and option grants — as a live single source of truth that investors and auditors rely on

citations.quote: Track, issue, and report equity with a single source of truth for founders, investors, and employees.
giving founders, finance teams, and investors a real-time view of ownership
Set up and manage stock option plans, grants, vesting, and exercises globally.
Issue, track, and model equity ownership with Qapita's cap table management software.
